g.text: sof-discord-bot
A Discord webhook bot for Soldier of Fortune 1 servers: it subscribes to
sof-export-fire
events, reads the info snapshot the game just wrote, renders a scoreboard image, and posts it.
Entry points
Core
State
External
`sof-discord-bot` · console script → `cli.main` → `run_watcher`, one blocking loop
`sofplus/addons/info_client.func` · snapshots server and players into cvars, then fires `discord`
`sofplus/addons/ext_trigger.func` · vendored trigger helper: one file write per event
`sofplus/addons/sp_sc_timer_2.func` · vendored timer helper the snapshots run on
`systemd/` · bot unit plus the export-fire unit it depends on
`trigger_client.subscribe_forever` · JSON lines: hello, subscribe, ping· reconnect with backoff
`DiscordTriggerHandler.handle_trigger` · per-event domain logic · skip when no active players
`exporter.read_data_from_sof_server` · server.cfg + player files + the trigger file
`set "k" "v"` regex · strips `_sp_sv_info_` and `~discord_` prefixes, coerce ints
`scoreboard.generate_screenshot_for_port` · PIL composite: map, portraits, text, flags
`discorder.generate_payload` / `send_to_discord` · embed plus PNG, `?wait=true`, URL masked in logs
`logging_utils` · one format, level from `SOF_BOT_LOG`
`fakedata.py` · sample players for developers, imported by nothing
`.env` / systemd `EnvironmentFile` · webhooks, host, port, log level
`user-<port>/sofplus/data/` · `info_server`, `info_client(_snap)`, `ext_trigger`
`src/.../assets/` · conchars, flags, optional map screenshots
`base/pak0.pak`, `pak2.pak` · portraits and conchars, cached per process
`_last_seq` per port · in memory only, used to warn on restarts
`sof-export-fire` on 127.0.0.1:8765 · separate install, owns watching and dedupe
Discord webhook API · embed JSON, then multipart PNG
SoF server plus SoFplus · writes every file this bot reads
vendored `pak.py`, `m32lib.py` · PAK index and M32 mip decoding
one dict per event
what port, which data dir
raw cfg files in
players in, PNG out
image plus embed
the game fires, the bot wakes
subscribe in, webhook out
